title: Extension by zero commutes naturally with integral reduction.
statement: Let k be a field, U and X separated schemes of finite type over k, and j:U→X an open immersion over k. Let l be prime and E any finite extension of Q_l. In the ordinary unbounded derived categories over the pulled-back continuous condensed O_E coefficient rings, D(j_!) commutes naturally with derived tensor by O_E/π_E^n, regarded as an integral module, for every n≥0. No boundedness or completeness of the argument is required.

source.place: proof (1), reduction modulo a uniformizer power

proof.text: Specialize the locally closed projection formula to j followed by the identity. The exact derived direct image of the identity is naturally the identity, by lowerStarId and rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Flip the bifunctor isomorphism and evaluate at the degree-zero quotient on X. Coefficient pullback from the point composes with upperStar Λ j by mapModCompIso and the restriction-extension equivalence for the invertible condensedPullbackHom. Exact derived pullback commutes with singleFunctor, identifying the pulled-back quotient on X with the quotient on U. Map this isomorphism through the flipped derived tensor and compose. The comparison is natural in the arbitrary derived object and applies also to n=0, with no use of a positive-power resolution.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1), reduction; A3 specialization of the existing projection formula

theorem integralOpenExtensionReduction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [U.Over (Spec (.of k))] [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] :
    ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
      ((openImmersionLowerShriek (integralCoefficientRing l E) j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          integralReductionFunctor l E X n ≅
        integralReductionFunctor l E U n ⋙
          (openImmersionLowerShriek (integralCoefficientRing l E) j).mapDerivedCategory)
